title: Open a page in Firefox and sign its guest book form

capabilities.why: Firefox (ESR or not), python3 for the page's server, and xdotool, which setup places the window with.
argv: (command -v firefox-esr || command -v firefox) && command -v python3 && command -v xdotool

setup.why: Write the guest book's server and a fresh Firefox profile that skips the first-run pages.

argv:
d=/tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}; rm -rf $d && mkdir -p $d/profile || exit 1
cat > $d/server.py <<'PY'
{{file:server.py}}
PY
cat > $d/profile/user.js <<'JS'
{{file:user.js}}
JS

setup.why: Serve the guest book on 127.0.0.1:{{port}}: the form, and the signing, which appends the name to the run's guestbook file.
Prove the page is served before the agent starts (10 s at most).

argv: for i in $(seq 1 50); do python3 -c 'import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:{{port}}/", timeout=1)' 2>/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 0.2; done; echo the guest book is not served on port {{port}} >&2; exit 1

setup.why: Open Firefox on a blank page with the run's profile.

argv: export DISPLAY=:$(ls /tmp/.X11-unix | sed -n s/^X//p | head -n1); b=$(command -v firefox-esr || command -v firefox); exec $b --new-instance --profile /tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}/profile about:blank

setup.why: Wait for Firefox's window (40 s at most), make it fill the screen, and put the pointer on it: with no window manager, keys go to the window under the pointer.

argv: export DISPLAY=:$(ls /tmp/.X11-unix | sed -n s/^X//p | head -n1); w=$(timeout 40 xdotool search --sync --onlyvisible --class firefox | head -n1); [ -n "$w" ] || { echo no Firefox window in 40 s >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 3; eval $(xdotool getdisplaygeometry --shell); xdotool windowmove $w 0 0 windowsize $w $WIDTH $HEIGHT; xdotool mousemove $((WIDTH / 2)) $((HEIGHT / 2)); sleep 1

instruction: In Firefox, open http://127.0.0.1:{{port}}/ and sign the guest book there with the name "{{g.name}} {{nonce}}". This desktop has no window manager: keys go to the window under the mouse pointer.

checks.why: The guest book's server wrote each name signed to the run's guestbook file: it holds this one name, signed once. The file is made by the first signing, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Close Firefox and stop the run's server (the bracket keeps pkill's pattern from matching this shell), and delete the run's folder.

oracle.why: Go to the page through the address bar (Ctrl+L, the address, Enter); the name field has the focus once the page loads: type the name and press Enter to submit.
